name: @guardbee/mcp-dns-intelligence
description: MCP server that enumerates DNS records, detects misconfigurations, and identifies dangling subdomains
long_description: Enumerates DNS records for a domain, checks SPF/DMARC/DKIM email security configuration, scans common subdomains for dangling/takeover candidates, and supports targeted lookups by record type. No API key required.
